connections.why: The press story lists a type metal of lead, tin and antimony among Gutenberg’s inventions; this frame asks what that metal was, and why the mixture melts lower than lead.
The 42-line Bible needed tens of thousands of pieces of type, cast from a metal whose recipe nobody wrote down.
